import subprocess,re,collections
s=subprocess.check_output(['samtools','view','variant.status.q1.bam','chrX:154398500-154398500'],text=True)
counts=collections.Counter()
for line in s.splitlines():
 f=line.split('\\t'); ref=int(f[3]); q=0
 for n,op in re.findall(r'(\\d+)([MIDNSHP=X])',f[5]):
  n=int(n)
  if op in 'M=X':
   if ref<=154398500<ref+n:
    idx=q+154398500-ref; base=f[9][idx]; cycle=len(f[9])-idx if int(f[1])&16 else idx+1
    counts[(base,cycle)]+=1
   ref+=n;q+=n
  elif op in 'DN': ref+=n
  elif op in 'IS': q+=n
print('Allele and read cycle counts:',dict(sorted(counts.items())))
PY"
